I can see the bug. In `mpz_init_set_str`, when the string starts with `-`, the code does `s++` but does NOT decrement `len`. Then the loop `for (i = len-1;; i--)` iterates over `len` characters starting from `s[len-1]`, but since `s` was incremented, `s[len-1]` reads one byte past the end of the actual string (which is now `len-1` bytes). This is a heap-buffer-overflow/use-after-free.
